sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 890 x 383 x 700 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Genelec 1234A operating manual D0127R001a (distributor-hosted copy of the manufacturer manual) and the Genelec page, opened 2026-11-12: monitor enclosure 700 x 890 x 383 mm (H x W x D), 73 kg, 160 litre, two 305 mm bass drivers, a 125 mm midrange and a 25 mm treble in a rotatable waveguide plate; the enclosure has two four-pole speakON sockets and an RJ45 LED socket on its rear, no mains and no power switch. ALL signal inputs (XLR analog, XLR AES/EBU in and thru, two GLM RJ45), the two speakON outputs and the mains inlet are on the separate 3U RAM-XL amplifier (132 x 483 x 286 mm), which is not part of the plan size. The Bêta proposal lists the RAM-XL ports and a Bêta row keeps its proposal ports exactly, so they are placed on the rear of the enclosure as a stand-in for the system; the mains inlet type is not named. Beta-modelled, no controls, patch-only. Source summary of the drivers: picture only. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
